data.body:
CLOSED — change 1633 MERGED as 4ffac529 and replicated to the GitHub mirror.

## Landing

Submitted after ps3 carried LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. Gerrit rebased server-side onto 1abe10e4 (Rebase-If-Necessary), so the landed commit is 4ffac529, not my local sha — 'git merge --ff-only' correctly refused, and I realigned my throwaway worktree with a reset to the landed commit rather than touching the shared checkout. The GitHub mirror lagged by one commit for a few minutes; it now carries scripts/summarize_ci_failures.py.

The ps3 Verified -1 before that was infrastructure, not code: the single failing job (bounded mutation gate, push-policy shard) never ran a mutant because the patchset checkout died three times on 'server certificate verification failed', ending outcome=failure. ps2 was green on identical production code and ps3 added only tests plus a rebase, so recheck was the right call and cleared it.

## All 10 ACs verified against the LANDED tree (4ffac529), 39 tests

- AC1 timed out named + duration -> test_timed_out_job_is_named_and_reports_duration, plus _explains_that_a_timeout_is_not_a_verdict and _explicit_timed_out_conclusion_needs_no_annotation
- AC2 three outcomes worded differently -> test_the_three_outcomes_render_distinctly, _cancelled_without_timeout_annotation_is_not_called_a_timeout, _failed_job_is_reported_as_failed
- AC3 green run posts nothing -> test_all_successful_jobs_produce_no_summary, _empty_job_list, _skipped_jobs_are_not_reported, _entrypoint_is_silent_on_a_green_run
- AC4 SSH post, no label, guarded -> test_the_comment_step_casts_no_label, _only_runs_on_a_non_success_vote
- AC5 vote-type expression unchanged -> test_cast_step_still_votes_the_normalized_conclusion, _only_one_step_casts_a_vote
- AC6 vote.needs unchanged -> check_verify_gate_parity.py OK + test_vote_needs_are_unchanged
- AC7 cannot change the gate outcome -> test_the_new_steps_cannot_fail_the_vote_job, _the_comment_is_posted_after_the_vote_is_cast
- AC8 quote cannot escape quoting -> test_a_quote_in_a_job_name_cannot_break_out_of_the_quoting, plus backslash and control-character tests
- AC9 SSH actually reaches Gerrit -> _uses_the_gerrit_ssh_port (29418), _installs_the_key_and_known_hosts, _private_key_is_removed_afterwards, _change_and_patchset_are_validated_before_the_remote_call
- AC10 both inputs fetched -> _fetches_check_run_annotations, _fetches_this_runs_jobs, _the_workflow_can_read_annotations

check_comment_hygiene.py clean on the landed tree.

## Class: preexisting

Not a regression — nothing that used to work broke. The vote job has cast its label through gerrit-review-action since the gate was built, and that action has always self-built '<STATUS>: <url>'. The gap was there from the original implementation and only became painful once the bounded mutation gate made 30-minute timeouts common. Not env_integration (the mechanism was in our workflow, not the environment), not flaky (deterministic), not plan_defect (the original gate plan simply never specified carrying failure detail).

## What this ticket is NOT

Both original premises were refuted and are preserved in the comments above: the concurrency group was never mis-keyed, and the all-shards timeout was already fixed on main by ac0f62be's per-shard parallel matrix. Only the observability gap was real. A future reader chasing 'CANCELLED' votes should start from the annotation text, not the concurrency group.
